answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking correlated equivocation proofs: if k identities coordinate conflicting votes, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies a compounded exponential capital-loss multiplier across the swarm through escrow slashing and asymmetric depreciation. Thus a dune, falcon, or prism label offers no isolation; shared control makes every dishonest identity economically expose the others.
